posts.title: HTB: PingPong
posts.description: PingPong is an assume breach Active Directory box with two forests joined by a bidirectional trust. I’ll abuse ESC13 to get a certificate whose issuance policy maps to a group with WinRM access, and get a shell on the first DC. posts.title: HTB: Nimbus
posts.description: Nimbus is a Linux box hosting a job scheduler website backed by an emulated AWS environment. I’ll abuse a server-side request forgery in the job submission form, bypassing a string block list with a decimal IP address to reach the instance metadata service and steal AWS credentials. posts.title: HTB: Garfield
posts.description: Garfield is an assume breach Active Directory box with a read-only domain controller hidden on an internal network behind the main DC. I’ll find I can write the logon script path for other users as well as files in the SYSVOL scripts folder, and use that to get a shell as the next user.
